name: foundry-agentic-loop
description: Build agentic solutions on Microsoft Foundry, GitHub and Azure. Prototype in an existing Foundry project, or run spec-driven development (SDD): a dynamic workflow that specifies, implements, verifies and deploys with azd behind evidence gates. Includes a canvas with a gallery of 61 industry prompt templates, a live workflow view and Foundry enablement, plus an improve mode that learns from past runs.
